sentences.text: This extinct arthrodire placoderm inhabited ancient seas during the Late Devonian era.
Taxonomically, it sits within the superfamily Incisoscutoidea and the clade Coccosteomorphi.
It possessed sharp, enamel-like blades along its jaw edges to seize prey.
Fossils date to a specific window between 382.31 and 379 million years ago.
Remains were unearthed in Kimberley, Australia.
Scientists Miles and Dennis formally named the genus in 1979.
